Privacy policy

Last updated 24 August 2026

This policy explains what personal data Golfsocial collects, why, and the rights you have. It covers both the Golfsocial app and this website. We keep it short, and we only collect what we actually need.

Who we are

Golfsocial is the data controller for the personal data covered by this policy. You can reach us any time at hello@golfsocial.club.

What we collect in the app

When you create an account, we process your name, your email address and the profile details you choose to add, for example a profile photo or your home club. You can sign in with Apple or Google; in that case we receive your name and email from them, and never your password.

When you use the app, we process your golf activity: rounds, scores, statistics, the courses you play, and live scores you choose to share. If you choose to connect your DGU profile, you sign in with GolfBox, and we receive your membership number, your club and your handicap. If you submit a score for your official handicap, it is sent to GolfBox.

Content you share in the app, such as posts, photos, comments, reactions, friends and groups, is stored so it can be shown to you and the people you share it with.

We also collect technical and usage data: your device model, operating system, app version and how the app is used, measured with the analytics tool PostHog on servers in the EU. If you turn on notifications, we process a technical push token for your device. If you use the app without an account, we only process technical and usage data.

To measure whether our ads work, the app sends a small number of events, for example that a sign-up was completed, to Meta, and receives install referrer data from Google Play. This happens within what your device settings allow, and we never sell your data to anyone.

What we collect on the website

If you sign up for our newsletter, we collect the email address you enter. That is the only personal data the website asks you for. Beyond that, we use Google Analytics to understand traffic on the site. It collects usage data such as which pages you view, your browser and device, and an approximate location derived from your IP address, and it sets cookies.

When you visit, our hosting provider automatically processes standard technical information, such as your IP address and browser type, in order to deliver the website and keep it secure. We do not use this to identify or profile you.

Why, and the legal basis

We process your account details, your golf activity and your content in order to provide the app to you. The legal basis is our agreement with you, GDPR Article 6(1)(b). Connecting your DGU profile, notifications and the newsletter are based on your consent, Article 6(1)(a), which you can withdraw at any time. Analytics, security and ad measurement are based on our legitimate interest in understanding, improving and marketing Golfsocial, Article 6(1)(f).

Who processes your data

The app’s data is stored with Amazon Web Services on servers in Stockholm, within the EU. Photos and videos are delivered through a content delivery network (Amazon CloudFront), which may cache copies closer to users. PostHog processes usage data on servers in the EU. If you sign in with Apple or Google, they handle the sign-in under their own policies. GolfBox and the Danish Golf Union are independently responsible for the official handicap register. Meta processes the ad measurement events described above. On the website we use MailerLite for the newsletter and Google Analytics for traffic measurement; both act as our data processors under data processing agreements. We never sell or rent your data, and we only share it where the law requires us to.

Where your data is stored

Your data is stored within the EU/EEA. Where a provider needs to process data outside the EU/EEA, for example when caching in a content delivery network or when measuring ads, we make sure an appropriate safeguard is in place, such as the European Commission’s standard contractual clauses.

How long we keep it

We keep your account data and your content for as long as your account exists. You can delete your account directly in the app under Settings, or by writing to us. When you delete your account, we delete or anonymise the personal data linked to it, unless the law requires us to keep something longer. Scores you have already submitted for your official handicap live with GolfBox and the DGU under their rules. We keep your newsletter email until you unsubscribe; every newsletter has a one-click unsubscribe link. Technical server data is kept only briefly, for security and troubleshooting.

Security

We take reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your data against loss, misuse and unauthorised access. Access to personal data is limited to people who need it.

Your rights

Under the GDPR you have the right to:

  • access the data we hold about you;
  • have it corrected or deleted;
  • restrict or object to how we use it;
  • receive it in a portable format;
  • and withdraw your consent at any time.

To use any of these rights, email hello@golfsocial.club, and we will respond within one month. Withdrawing your consent does not affect anything we lawfully did before you withdrew it.

Automated decisions and profiling

We do not use your data for automated decisions that have legal or similarly significant effects on you. Handicap calculation follows golf’s official rules and is based only on the scores you submit yourself.

Children

The app and the website are not directed at children. We do not knowingly collect data from anyone under 13 without consent from a holder of parental responsibility.

Cookies and local storage

This website uses Google Analytics, which sets analytics cookies, for example _ga, to recognise returning visits and measure use of the site. We store your language choice locally in your browser so the site remembers it. That is functional only and never leaves your device. You can opt out of analytics by blocking cookies in your browser or by using Google’s browser add-on for opting out of Google Analytics. The app does not use cookies, but stores your login and settings securely on your device.

Complaints

If you believe we handle your data incorrectly, you have the right to complain to the Danish Data Protection Agency, Datatilsynet, at datatilsynet.dk.

Changes to this policy

If we change this policy, we will update the date at the top, and for material changes we will let you know in the app or by email.

Contact

Questions about your data? Write to hello@golfsocial.club.
